configurePresets.name: linux-ci
configurePresets.displayName: Linux host: engine tests + contract checks
configurePresets.description: What the ubuntu job runs: no Windows headers, no MinGW, all 16 tests plus check_m1/check_docs/mkdat.

configurePresets.name: win32-mingw
configurePresets.description: The shippable product form. Run from a MINGW32 shell so g++/windres are the i686 ones.

configurePresets.name: win32-trace
configurePresets.displayName: MinGW-w64 i686: standalone with the trace channel
configurePresets.description: Same product plus C:\rospinyin-trace.log lines. Bigger binary; never shipped.

configurePresets.name: win32-intree
configurePresets.description: ROSPINYIN_IN_TREE=ON: no installer, no rhash (ReactOS's build owns registration).

configurePresets.name: win32-toy
configurePresets.description: ROSPINYIN_SCHEME=toy. Proves a second input method is a folder, not a framework patch. Not shippable.

configurePresets.name: win32-cross
configurePresets.description: For machines without a MINGW32 shell. Requires ROSPINYIN_MINGW_TOOLCHAIN to point at a toolchain file whose compiler is i686-w64-mingw32-g++ (and the matching -posix suffixed CC/RC).
